title: Loop repair — what Gauss projection removes and what it cannot touch
description: A box-filling longitudinal mode superposed on the flux-cell ring, run with Gauss projection as the only active term, so each tick is one projection pass. The longitudinal mode is removed within about five ticks; the ring and every loop sum of the field are left unchanged. All initial data is [IMPOSED]. View the mid-plane flux slice with the curlJ channel (static) against the divergence channel (fades).
